title.en: It’s been a while since we did an Island Snapshot

subtitle.en: One more island snapshot, plus the current puzzle count.
subtitle.zh: 再来一张岛屿快照，外加目前的谜题数量。

blocks.en: Luis has been doing a lot of work lately on the mountain and especially the stuff at the top.
blocks.zh: Luis 最近在山体上做了很多工作，尤其是山顶那部分。

blocks.en: Other folks have been doing a bunch of work on things that are not as obvious in this picture!
blocks.zh: 其他人也在忙一堆在这张图里不太看得出来的东西！
